description:
APP Kirrane Auctioneering are delighted to offer to the market this guilt edged investment opportunity.  Located in the heart of Kilkelly Village ,close to Knock International Airport and within walking distance of all amenities this stunning property offers a unique investment opportunity.  

The property consists of 3 no Apartments.  All fully furnished and with sitting tenants.  The units have been finished to a very high standard recently renovated.  All tenants are registered with RTB.  The property is fire compliant.  The block comes with a gross yield of 11 percent  passing rent.  

Apartment 1 is a One bedroom ground floor apartment with private front door access.  The property briefly consists of:
Open plan kitchen, living dining area with timber and tiled flooring, modern kitchen and good quality appliances.   Modern bathroom fully tiled and fitted with white bathroom ware.  Double bedroom offering timber flooring, fitted wardrobes, curtain pole and nicely painted,  Fitted with electric heating.  The property consists of 500 sq. ft approximately and offers a C2 Building Energy Rating Certificate. 

Apartment 2 consists of a two bedroom apartment located on the ground floor with side door private access. Offering 665 sq ft accommodation approximately.  Building Energy Rating of D1.  Beautifully presented and offering an open plan kitchen, living and dining area fitted with modern kitchen and good quality appliances.  Two double bedrooms with timber flooring, curtain poles, fitted wardrobes and nicely painted.  Large fully tiled bathroom with white bathroom ware installed.  

Apartment 3  is a three bedroom large apartment on the first floor with one bedroom ensuite.  Consisting of 1235 sq. ft approximately and offers spacious living and sleeping accommodation.  Private own door access with carpet staircase.  Open plan living area, Kitchen/ dining area, 3 bedrooms.  Modern kitchen installed offering ample worktop and storage space.  Large fully tiled bathroom and fitted with white bathroom ware.  Attention to detail throughout.  The Building Energy Rating for this apartment is C1.   

All apartments are rented with a passing rent of 28,080 p.a. to increase to 28,680 in November 2026.    

For further information or to arrange viewing please make contact with the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering "we don't just list properties we sell them".  All offers and negotiation go through the Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering.
